request.input:
1girl, solo, adult female swordswoman, dual wielding, exactly two swords, each hand firmly grips a different sword hilt. Her right hand on image left holds a white gold luminous straight sword with an ornate gold crossguard and a thin circular golden halo around its hilt. Her left hand on image right holds a black straight longsword with glowing crimson edges, a black angular crossguard and black wrapped grip. Both blades point diagonally upward toward opposite upper corners, clearly separated, no blade covers her face.

Fantasy ability card, heroic confident dual sword stance, two contrasting sacred and demon-slaying weapons.

Horizontal thigh-up close shot, heroine central and large, both hands and both sword hilts visible beside waist, blades framing her head in an open V, cropped blade tips allowed. Gentle low camera, ponytail and skirt flow to side, strong silhouette.

Simple abstract deep blue large painted background, pale gold light on left, dark crimson accent on right. Weapons have solid readable blade shapes, restrained magical light, no scenery, no text.
